visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young woman with short brown hair and a cream-colored ribbed shirt speaks to the camera in a brightly lit indoor living room setting with a beige sofa and grey curtains. (2) Hands hold a bear-shaped makeup puff next to a Rilakkuma box, followed by two small circular blush containers on a marble surface. (3) The woman demonstrates applying blush to her right cheek using the small bear-shaped puff on her finger while smiling. (4) Close-up of a teal face mask packet being held, followed by hands removing a wet, white sheet mask from the packaging. (5) The woman is in a bathroom setting, applying the white sheet mask to her face and smoothing it out with her fingers. (6) A pink electric eyelash curler with a glowing blue light is shown, then the woman uses it to curl her eyelashes. (7) Close-up of the woman applying black mascara to her upper lashes, showing the difference in eye makeup. (8) The woman holds a pink square-headed hairbrush with a hollowed-out center, gesturing to explain its design. (9) The woman uses a pink hair dryer blowing through the hollow hairbrush as she brushes her damp hair in a bathroom. (10) The woman holds two Hello Kitty plushies, one in a school uniform and one in a black dress, and hangs the black one on a leather handbag.
visual_base.text_narrative_log: (1) [Logo]: DON DON DONKI. [Slogan]: 去日本唐吉訶德到底要買些什麼呢. (2) [Slogan]: 首先是這個懶熊拇指粉撲. (3) [Slogan]: 他可以放進CANMAKE的腮紅裡面. (4) [Slogan]: 變成一個超可愛的組合. (5) [Slogan]: 有了粉撲也讓腮紅可以上得很均勻. (6) [Slogan]: 就像從肌膚透出來的自然氣色. (7) [Slogan]: 然後是Lululun的Hydra AZ 杜鵑花酸面膜. (8) [Slogan]: 在 @cosme 2025上半年最佳美妝大賞「面膜部門」得到第一名的厲害面膜. (9) [Slogan]: 他是化妝水型的面膜可以每天使用. (10) [Slogan]: 面膜紙觸感溫和柔軟溫和像融化一樣貼合肌膚. (11) [Slogan]: 清爽的杜鵑花酸面膜很適合台灣的天氣. (12) [Slogan]: 敷起來水潤不粘膩. (13) [Slogan]: 早上妝前使用底妝就會變得很服貼. (14) [Slogan]: 再來是kissme的電熱睫毛夾. (15) [Slogan]: 用USB充電超神奇可以夾到睫毛根部但不會燙. (16) [Slogan]: 哦有欸你看這兩隻不一樣厲害. (17) [Slogan]: 刷上睫毛膏捲度可以維持一整天. (18) [Slogan]: 還有速乾髮梳真的不是智商稅. (19) [Slogan]: 洗完頭髮可以舒服地把濕髮梳開. (20) [Slogan]: 這些洞洞讓風跟頭髮接觸面積變大了就能更快乾. (21) [Slogan]: 隔天早上起來頭髮還是很聽話. (22) [Slogan]: 最後現在唐吉訶德都有三麗鷗專區. (23) [Slogan]: 有機會找到最近很紅的長腿Kitty. (24) [Slogan]: 掛在包包上非常可愛. (25) [Slogan]: 以上就是這次的分享啦. (26) [Slogan]: 大家去日本逛唐吉訶德的時候也別忘記找找看囉.

visual_human_presence.mainCharacterDescription: A young woman with short, straight brown hair, light makeup, wearing a cream-colored ribbed long-sleeved polo shirt.

visual_scene_and_style.backgroundDescribe: A modern indoor home environment featuring a neutral-toned sofa with plush pink pillows and grey curtains in the living room, and a wood-paneled bathroom.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) Cheerful female voice introduces the video over an upbeat, major-mode synth-pop track with a strong 4/4 beat. (2) Soft digital 'pop' SFX accompanies the introduction of the makeup puff. (3) A distinct plastic 'click' sound is heard as the makeup container is manipulated, mixed with rhythmic electronic music. (4) Crisp plastic rustling SFX marks the opening of the mask packet, followed by a slight damp 'squish' sound as the mask is unfolded. (5) The female voice continues with a clear, enunciated tone, describing skin benefits while high-energy music maintains the pace. (6) A mechanical 'click' and a subtle electronic 'hum' indicate the activation of the electric curler. (7) Loud broadband noise from a hair dryer enters the mix, briefly competing with the voice, before a transition 'whoosh' SFX leads into the next section. (8) High-pitched bell SFX highlights the presentation of the Hello Kitty charms as the music swells for the conclusion. (9) Outro voice and music finish with a friendly rising intonation and a final digital chime.

narrative_and_purpose.narrativeStructure: List-based: Hook -> Sequence of Product Recommendations -> Conclusion -> CTA
narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: To recommend specific viral beauty and lifestyle products found at Don Don Donki in Japan by demonstrating their practical usage and aesthetic appeal. The video serves as a shopping guide for tourists visiting Japan who are interested in makeup, skincare, and character goods.

endorsement_analysis.endorsementCues: Detailed positive review and usage demonstration of specific brands (Canmake, Lululun, KissMe, Sanrio) within the retail context of Don Don Donki.

high_inference.freeDescribe: High-density social media style edit with heavy use of on-screen text and fast cuts to maintain viewer engagement.
